decisions.reason: An organic vegan superfood drink mix sits far outside the firm's waste-to-energy plant engineering core, only got a website mention, and is likely to be dropped as the firm focuses its resources.
Modular plant extensions complement the firm's waste-to-energy offering and can be sold to existing plant customers at low extra cost.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own dedicated page, which suggests it is a flagship product the firm is actively promoting.
Plastic-waste-to-fuel fits the core technology and growing recycling demand, though the market is uncertain and the product only got a website mention.
